description: This file defines a React component called Users that renders a user management page. It fetches a list of users from an API, displays user details in a table, and allows toggling user enabled status via API calls.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of users from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the enabled state of a user, then reloads the user list.
